say:3:1422417002:0.text: Ha! Yeah, we were repairing the pavement in the royal city when their queen died.
say:3:1422417002:0.source_cn: 嘿嘿，那会儿咱正在他们王城修缮地板。他们女王不是死了吗？

say:3:1422417002:0.female: Ha! Yeah, we were repairing the pavement in the royal city when their queen died.

say:4:1422417003:0.text: It was chaos out there. We were wandering around and trying to find out way back. Then I saw this rock...
say:4:1422417003:0.source_cn: 秩序就乱了，咱就在那里闲逛。结果看到了这块石头——

say:6:1422417004:0.text: This material... I've never seen anything this peculiar! The texture, the hardness—it's perfect.
say:6:1422417004:0.source_cn: 这块石头的材质……我从没见过这么奇特的！看这纹理，这硬...
say:6:1422417004:0.male: This material... I've never seen anything this peculiar! The texture, the hardness—it's perfect.
say:6:1422417004:0.female: This material... I've never seen anything this peculiar! The texture, the hardness—it's perfect.

say:10:1422417006:0.text: Alright, I got it! We dwarves don't understand magic. I know you're a mage. If you tell me it's dangerous, I believe you.
say:10:1422417006:0.source_cn: 好吧，咱矮人不懂魔法，你个魔法师说危险咱就信！

say:11:1422417007:0.source_cn: 但就这么交出来也太可惜了。要不，咱跟你谈个交易？
